name: Jih Lin Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Jih Lin Technology Co., Ltd., established in Kaohsiung, Taiwan, in 2000, operates as a global producer and vendor of lead frames. Their comprehensive product line encompasses lead frames specifically engineered for a multitude of electronic applications, such as high and low power discrete transistors, surface mount devices, bridge/DIP rectifiers, optoelectronic/LED components, power discrete clips, and integrated circuits. Furthermore, they supply intelligent power modules and diode lead wires. These vital products are extensively employed in computer vehicle components, power supply units, smartphones, television power converters, and climate control systems like air conditioners and refrigerators.
